plan_point: 77.44.7.D / D-06 — mounted media picker synchronization with external Page Model state
gap: The media picker already exposed a selection-view synchronization hook used by mounted Inspector subscriptions, but the real browser picker lifecycle did not assert that an external model update refreshes and closes the mounted view without emitting another user-selection callback.

behavior: In the real Chromium media-picker fixture at mobile and desktop widths, an external Page Model selection update closes the open picker and changes its selected-image preview.
Clearing the external Page Model selection removes the stale selected preview.
Neither synchronization nor clearing emits the picker onSelect callback, keeping model-to-view synchronization separate from user authoring commands.
change.scope_note: The browser test invokes the exported synchronization hook directly; it validates the mounted-view contract used by Inspector subscriptions, not a full end-to-end Undo/Redo gesture or a Save/Publish network lifecycle.
